mintAuthority.summary: fLiteUSD is a UUPS-upgradeable ERC-4626 strategy vault over Ethereum USDC. Current share minting occurs exclusively against deposited USDC in deposit/mint with no privileged share-minter. However, primary owner FluidTimelockController (24-hour delay, proposed by a 6-of-12 Avocado multisig and executed by a 3-of-5 Safe) can upgrade the vault implementation via UUPS, secondary owner can pause deposits and withdrawals immediately, and upgradeable StrategyHandler can pull USDC funds and set exchange-price accrual parameters. Native USDC issuance remains inherited from usdc-circle.
mintAuthority.headline: Deposits back fLiteUSD shares; 24-hour timelocked UUPS upgrades and StrategyHandler fund pulls remain, while USDC stays upstream.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: At finalized Ethereum block 26506658 (hash 0x2b69b7934b1e88fb42e9f10e6d0bff1f9114b5f1334c87ee41cc2aa8c9210f31), verified FluidLiteVault implementation 0xe16ccc91a8134d428e7b6240177f9e2b227b9743 creates shares solely inside deposit() and mint() after USDC.safeTransferFrom and FUSDC.deposit. No privileged arbitrary share-mint entrypoint exists in the current implementation. Primary owner FluidTimelockController holds upgrade-only UUPS authority (24-hour delay), which is tracked separately under upgradeability. Parent USDC issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency on usdc-circle.
